what: Atmos Energy distributes natural gas to about 3.4 million customers across eight states, with Texas by far its largest market. It is purely a gas distributor and pipeline operator, with no electricity business.
customers: Households, businesses, public authorities and industrial users, mostly in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Kentucky.
money: regulated gas delivery to end customers
moat: A regulated monopoly over gas distribution in fast-growing Texan cities, plus its own intrastate pipeline that connects supply to its own customers.
risks: Debt of about $11 billion against almost no cash
Long-term decarbonisation policy is a risk to gas distribution everywhere
Winter storms have caused large gas cost spikes before
opportunities: Operating margin of 37% with a 29% net margin
Population growth in Texas adds customers every year without needing acquisitions
Regulatory mechanisms in Texas allow faster recovery of investment than in many states
watch: Customer growth in Texas and rate case outcomes.
